findings.evidence: Basic.lean:217-233 `gaPointParamMul`/`gaPointsMulEquiv_gaPointParamMul`; Scheme.lean:333-336 `schemePointsMulEquiv` definition; Scheme.lean:396 `schemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply ... := rfl`; grep for `gaSchemePointParamMul` shows no lemma relating it to `gaPointParamMul`.
findings.fix: Define `gaSchemePointParamMul A p q := groupSchemePointMulEquiv A (gaPointParamMul ((groupSchemePointMulEquiv A).symm p) ((groupSchemePointMulEquiv A).symm q))` (definitionally the current body, so the call sites in SpecialLinear/ChevalleyRelations.lean are unaffected), and prove `schemePointsMulEquiv_gaSchemePointParamMul` from `schemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemePointMulEquiv` (Scheme.lean:377) plus `gaPointsMulEquiv_gaPointParamMul` (Basic.lean:227) rather than from `apply_symm_apply`.
findings.issue: `gaSchemePointParamMul` re-derives the existing parameter-product operation instead of reusing it. `TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointParamMul` (Basic.lean:217) is the same `(equiv).symm (ofAdd (toAdd _ * toAdd _))` assembly, and since `schemePointsMulEquiv A = (groupSchemePointMulEquiv A).symm.trans gaPointsMulEquiv` (Scheme.lean:333) with `schemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply` (line 396) proved by `rfl`, `gaSchemePointParamMul A p q` is definitionally `groupSchemePointMulEquiv A (gaPointParamMul ((groupSchemePointMulEquiv A).symm p) ((groupSchemePointMulEquiv A).symm q))`. No lemma links the two, so the algebra-point API (notably `mapValue_gaPointParamMul`, Basic.lean:245) does not carry over to the scheme-point operation.

findings.issue: `TauCeti.transvectionUnit_mul_transvectionUnit_eq_mul_mul` is now dead and redundant. Its only consumer was the old proof of `commutatorElement_transvectionUnit`, which this PR reroutes through `Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.commutatorElement_transvection`; `grep -rn transvectionUnit_mul_transvectionUnit_eq_mul_mul code/` returns only its own declaration. The statement `x·y = y·x·z` is a two-line consequence of the retained `commutatorElement_transvectionUnit` (line 186) together with `commute_transvectionUnit` (line 169), and the matrix-level content is already `TauCeti.transvection_mul_transvection_eq_mul_mul` (SpecialLinearGroup/Transvection.lean:656), which keeps its consumer at line 692.

summary: The new SLₙ Chevalley relations are genuinely new (Mathlib has no transvection commutator relations; `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Transvection.lean` only has `transvection_mul_transvection_same`), and routing `commutatorElement_transvectionUnit`/`commute_transvectionUnit` through the new `SpecialLinearGroup` lemmas is proper reuse. Two duplication defects remain: `gaSchemePointParamMul` re-derives the existing `gaPointParamMul` instead of transporting it, and `transvectionUnit_mul_transvectionUnit_eq_mul_mul` is left with no consumer and is a restatement of retained API. I withdraw the earlier reuse finding against `Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.commute_transvection`/`commutatorElement_transvection` (contested in the reply quoting discussion_r3789666229): they are per-type restatements at `SL n A` with six in-repo call sites, which the rubric's per-type-restatement carve-out covers.
